weaver_intimate.geometry: U-shaped conversation circle, armchairs spaced at 80-100cm for voice intimacy.

Introduce heavy boucle, textured linen, and jute rugs to soften the room's acoustic reflections.

weaver_dynamic.geometry: Seating pushed to boundaries to clear a central circulation lane for gathering traffic.

sovereign_clinical.geometry: Symmetrical desk orientation facing the room entrance (Command Sightline).
sovereign_clinical.chair: Ergonomic leather chair with high back, no rollers (fixed feet). Symmetrical alignment.

Install a multi-joint monitor arm to align the screen's top edge exactly with your eye level.
Mount a linear task bar light on top of the monitor to project glare-free light on the key axis.

Lay a thick wool carpet beneath the work chair to dampen footfall vibration and soften acoustics.

Position the desk perpendicular to the window to benefit from natural daylight without screen glare.
Set up a dual-circuit lighting grid with 4000K CCT daylight work spots and 2700K warm background lamps.

Choose an ergonomic task chair upholstered in soft linen to introduce tactile warmth.
Decorate open shelves with natural cedar boards and plants to create a welcoming, shared environment.
